BiblicalUsage: Tears, the word that covers weeping itself, from the psalmist who waters his couch with tears through the night to Hezekiah, whose tears God saw and answered with fifteen more years. Isaiah promises the day God wipes away tears from every face, and Ecclesiastes sees the tears of the oppressed with no one to comfort them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps every tear, and none of them is wasted. He saw Hezekiah's tears and He sees mine, and the promise that He will wipe them away is what lets me weep honestly now.
